text: Midcourse test track 2 Hello Today I'm going to talk about an animal that has a great environmental impact the beaver The beaver is similar to a rat, but it's much bigger with brown fur Sharp teeth and a long flat tail You probably know them They're famous for building dams which are like walls across rivers that stop the water from moving I'm going to talk today about the benefits of working with these animals rather than against them Many people don't realize that some wild animals can actually help us, but it's true We depend on some animals as much as they depend on us Many people see beavers as a threat to our environment They make trouble wherever they go. They cut down trees and make rivers flood But personally I don't think that beavers are a problem at all It seems to me that we are just starting to realize how important they are When humans first met beavers hundreds of years ago Humans didn't want to protect them. They wanted to kill them as a result beavers almost died out a Long time ago. They were very valuable The reason for this was that everyone wanted their fur in Europe and Asia and later in North America, too People used beaver fur to make clothes especially hats There were between 100 and 400 million beavers in North America before the Europeans arrived In the late 1800s, however, there were only 100,000 The beaver had become endangered The result of this was that lots of animal habitats were lost Beavers build dams which create wetlands large areas of land covered in water These wetlands provide food and a home for the beaver, but they also provide homes for other animals, too Frogs for example live in wetlands created by beavers Fish also use these wetlands to take care of their young and ducks make their homes near them, too Wetlands keep carbon dioxide a gas which makes the world's temperature rise out of the atmosphere And this is good because it stops the rise in temperature around the world The other way that beavers are helping with the climate crisis is by stopping forest fires Which create a lot of pollution and a lot of damage Wetlands made by beavers stop fires from getting bigger and they also provide protection for animals trying to escape the fires In England and Scotland beavers have recently returned Britain is a very wet place and every year floods cause millions of pounds of damage Due to the dams that beavers make, flood damage is reduced Because the water from floods goes to the wetlands instead Beavers help reduce flood water by up to 30% To sum up, beavers are helping us to solve some serious environmental problems We just have to let nature's engineers get on with their job
